text.text: Type: Unified Game Library | Scope: All Installed Platforms | Sorting: By System, Genre, or Favorite | Frontend: EmulationStation

text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The All Games collection brings together every title installed across your Batocera systems into a single browsable list. Rather than representing one console or platform, it serves as a unified library view, letting you explore your full collection regardless of which system a game originally belongs to. This collection is generated automatically by EmulationStation and updates as new games are added or removed from any configured platform. It's a convenient way to browse, search, or launch games without navigating into each individual system folder.
